Summer thesis

Identifiability follows the observation, not the optimizer.

Two parameters are globally recovered because real absolute anchors reach them. Two others are regionally identifiable in different basins. The two growth rates are excluded under time-mean observations.

This tool is the product that is accurate enough today. The emulator is not: it is physically improved, but it does not clear a strong forecast baseline.

Parameter pattern / corrected scoreboard

Four observable parameters, four distinct information geometries.

Recovery is not a single 4-of-4 score. Each parameter answers a different observational question, and the regional signals must remain regional.

alpfeglobal source scale
Near-saturated recovery across basins; the control showing that a global source-magnitude parameter can be constrained. This is recovery under the observation suite, not validation of Carroll's numerical value.
R_PICPOCreal calcite anchor
50/50 with the Daniels CP:PP anchor versus 6/50 in the epoch-matched anchor-off control. The result establishes anchor dependence, not a globally constant biological rain ratio.
scav_ratregional / Southern Ocean
Regional signal under the required geometric pooler, but still one unreplicated result and not transferable to Kerguelen. Local Fisher geometry makes vertical dissolved iron a leading symmetry-breaking candidate; conditioning did not guarantee recovery across basins.
diatomgrazregional / EqPac
Replicated out of sample at the strict 0.10 band against a 0/50 matched null. Training is anti-recovery in the other two basins, so a global aggregate would erase the actual pattern.
Smallgrow + Biggrowexcluded, not failed
Time-mean observables do not separate the pair. Smallgrow has a 9/10 North Atlantic seasonal prototype that remains unconfirmed; Biggrow stays unobservable by construction.

Track 2 / corrected emulator result

Physical validity improved. Forecast advantage did not.

Log-space training removed negative concentrations and restored dynamic range, but the strong baseline verdict is unchanged. That makes the emulator a research artifact, not a forecast product.

-0.161mean skill versus per-cell seasonal AR(1), four seeds; every confidence interval remains below zero.
+0.055mean skill versus persistence; confidence intervals straddle zero, so the apparent gain is not significant.
1 stepuseful horizon. The engineering win is physical state quality and speed, not demonstrated predictive superiority.
